statements.impact_statement: Applies only to this application's REST-only configuration guarded by SpringMvcExposureTest. No XsltView or XsltViewResolver beans or XSLT view configuration; application request handlers use response-body semantics. The official advisory requires XsltView rendering with a catch-all mapping and an implicit view name. Reassess upon view/configuration/version changes; see spring-mvc-vex-review.md.

Applies only to this application's REST-only configuration guarded by SpringMvcExposureTest. No SSE endpoints, SSE emitters, or view-fragment rendering in application handlers/configuration. The official advisory requires view fragments sent over SSE with attacker-controlled content. Reassess upon streaming/view/configuration/version changes; see spring-mvc-vex-review.md.
